tasks.title: Set up project environment
tasks.description: Initialize the project with necessary tools and frameworks to support API development and testing.
tasks.command: npm init && npm install express jest

tasks.title: Design API structure
tasks.description: Determine the endpoints, HTTP methods, and data structures that will be used for the TODO API, ensuring proper URL paths and naming conventions.

tasks.title: Implement API endpoints
tasks.description: Develop the routes for the CRUD operations: CREATE, READ, UPDATE, DELETE for managing TODO tasks.

tasks.title: Set up database or data storage
tasks.description: Choose and configure a suitable data storage solution, such as a JSON file, an in-memory database, or a small DB like SQLite, for persisting TODO tasks.

tasks.title: Develop unit tests for API endpoints
tasks.description: Create test cases for each API endpoint using a testing framework to verify that the API behaves as expected under different scenarios.

tasks.title: Perform integration testing
tasks.description: Conduct integration tests by making requests to the API, ensuring components work together seamlessly and data is correctly passed between layers.

tasks.title: Document API
tasks.description: Create comprehensive documentation for the API, including endpoint descriptions, usage examples, and any setup or environment configuration needed.

acceptance_criteria: The TODO API should expose endpoints to create, retrieve, update, and delete tasks.
Unit tests must cover edge cases and validate the correct behavior of each API endpoint.
Integration tests should confirm the full functionality of the API in a real-world simulation.
The API should return JSON responses for all endpoints in a consistent format.
Documentation should be clear and provide all necessary information for developers to use the API effectively.
